stories.title: Longtime Maritime broadcaster Todd Veinotte dies at 57
stories.summary: Long-time Maritime media personality and former Global News reporter, Todd Veinotte, has died at the age of 57.

stories.title: Bell reports sharp rise in copper wire thefts, vandalism at some Nova Scotia sites
stories.summary: The telecom giant issued a statement Monday saying that between Jan. 1 and Oct. 31, it recorded a total of 66 incidents of theft and vandalism.

stories.title: Nova Scotia officials warn toxic drugs increasingly mixed with veterinary sedative
stories.summary: Officials in Nova Scotia are warning that the unregulated drug supply is becoming more toxic as it's commonly laced with unknown ingredients, including strong veterinary sedatives.

stories.title: Settlement approved in N.S. First Nation class action over non-consensual MRI scans
stories.summary: A $400,000 settlement has been approved in a class action that alleged members of a Nova Scotia First Nation were subjected to MRI scans without their consent.

stories.title: Nova Scotia school support workers reject tentative deal, union weighs next steps
stories.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia said its members have rejected a tentative agreement with the employer.

stories.title: Canada’s Alert Ready emergency system will test notifications on Wednesday
stories.summary: The emergency alerts are used by governments to inform the public of emergencies including tornadoes, floods, wildfires and Amber Alerts

stories.title: Strong calving season provides glimmer of hope for endangered right whales
stories.summary: The most recent calving season for North Atlantic right whales was one of the strongest on record, providing a glimmer of hope for the critically endangered species.

stories.title: N.S. football player dies suddenly while attending U.S. boarding school
stories.summary: A talented young football player from Halifax, Nova Scotia, who was set to play in the NCAA next year has died while attending a boarding school in the United States.

stories.title: ‘How does space smell?’ Halifax students connect with Canadian astronaut aboard ISS
stories.summary: High school students in Halifax enjoyed the rare opportunity to chat with Canadian astronaut Joshua Kutryk, direct from the International Space Station.

stories.title: Halifax council backs long-term strategy for fire services as population grows
stories.summary: The Halifax Professional Fire Fighters Union is praising Halifax council for taking steps to develop a long-term service and resource strategy.
